description: Instructions for building a custom container image

script.description: Path to a build shell script (relative to profile directory or absolute)

commands.description: Inline build commands as an alternative to a script file

compression.description: Image compression algorithm (e.g. "none", "gzip", "xz"; empty = Incus default)

agents.description: AI agents to install in the base image (e.g. ["claude", "opencode"]); empty/unset installs all supported agents

cloud_init.description: Keep cloud-init enabled in the built coi image (default: false). Disabled by default because it runs on every container boot before the network comes up, delaying each start; coi containers do not need it. Takes effect on the next `coi build --force`.
